name: Minh, renting a room
desc: Year 2, lives in a shared room near campus. Allowance only.
tip: Rent is high, so needs may pass 50%. Cut wants first, keep saving at least 10%.

name: Lan, living at home
desc: Year 1, lives with family, no rent to pay.
tip: With no rent, try saving more than 20%. It's the easiest time to build a habit.

name: Huy, part-time barista
desc: Year 3, allowance plus a weekend part-time job.
tip: Income changes month to month. Budget on your lowest month and save any extra.
